deescalation_address: I beg your pardon, madam. I took you for a gentleman, and I was wrong.
Forgive me, madam -- I mistook you, and I shall not do so again.
I am sorry, I did not know you were a lady. I spoke in ignorance.
A thousand pardons, madam. The fault was mine and I own it.
Madam, I ask your pardon for my mistake.
